checks.name: Burst reconciles to raw transfer rows

evidence.sql: SELECT (SELECT max(hourly_transfers) FROM results.hourly_activity WHERE customer_id='C0506')=100 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM raw.source WHERE customer_id='C0506' AND transaction_type='transfer')=100

SELECT (SELECT source_accounts=25 AND transfers=100 AND abs(total_amount-9110.80)<0.001 FROM results.recipient_summary WHERE destination_account='A0999') AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT account_id)=25 AND count(*)=100 AND abs(sum(transaction_amount)-9110.80)<0.001 FROM raw.source WHERE destination_account='A0999' AND transaction_type='transfer')
SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id)=5 AND count(*)=100 AND min(repeated_transfer_count)=20 AND max(repeated_transfer_count)=20 FROM results.transaction_evidence WHERE repeated_modest_signal

SELECT (SELECT count(*)=532 AND count(*) FILTER(WHERE signal_count>0)=106 FROM results.customer_review) AND (SELECT count(*)=483 AND count(DISTINCT transaction_id)=483 FROM results.transaction_evidence)

findings.title: A concentrated burst
findings.detail: C0506 made 100 transfers in the clock hour starting 2025-03-02 00:00:00+00:00.
findings.query: SELECT * FROM results.hourly_activity ORDER BY hourly_transfers DESC LIMIT 1

findings.title: Many sources, one recipient
findings.detail: A0999 received 100 transfers from 25 distinct source accounts, totaling 9,110.80 synthetic amount units.
findings.query: SELECT * FROM results.recipient_summary ORDER BY source_accounts DESC, transfers DESC LIMIT 1

findings.title: Repeated modest payments
findings.detail: 5 customers had at least 5 similar modest transfers to the same recipient in a clock hour; 5 groups met the count and variation rules.
findings.query: SELECT customer_id, max(repeated_transfer_count) AS repeat_count FROM results.transaction_evidence WHERE repeated_modest_signal GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY repeat_count DESC

findings.title: A shift in spending
findings.detail: C0507 has a late-half median of 2,286.27 versus early-half 29.30 (78.0×).
findings.query: SELECT customer_id, early_median, late_median, behavior_ratio FROM results.customer_review ORDER BY behavior_ratio DESC LIMIT 1

limitations: Review scores are transparent rule counts, not probabilities, fraud labels or financial advice.
All data is synthetic; no accuracy or real-world crime detection claim is made.
Amounts are assumed to share a synthetic unit; no currency conversion is available.
Clock-hour boundaries can split bursts; shared recipients can have legitimate explanations.
Customer medians and chronological halves use the same observation period; this is retrospective description, not prospective prediction.
Thresholds are illustrative; sensitivity varies burst, amount and hub thresholds only. Repeated-payment and behavior rules are unchanged.
The generated solution notebook records module execution; notebook cells themselves were not run.
ui_verification: Rendered in the running Streamlit application and visually inspected in a browser; four metrics, four findings and four Plotly charts. Streamlit AppTest also passed.
